title: Where the asylums were: the rise, fall and afterlife of Britain's county asylums
excerpt: I mapped 233 of Britain's asylums and psychiatric hospitals from Wikipedia. Most were built between 1845 and 1914, almost none closed until the 1980s, and of the closed sites whose fate is known, 66% are now homes.
seo_description: A map of 233 British asylums and psychiatric hospitals: two waves of building, 83 closures in the 1990s, and what the sites are now.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Where the asylums were', with 'asylums' in brick red, on pale paper beside a map of Britain and Northern Ireland dotted with 233 coloured circles for asylums and psychiatric hospitals, clustered around London and the industrial North. Text: most opened between 1845 and 1914; 83 closed in the 1990s alone; two in three closed sites with a stated fate are now homes.
